boundaries.budget: VM step, requested-live-payload and call-depth limits stop evaluation with a stopped resource ledger; they are not semantic traps, allocator failure results or source cancellation. Native code does not inherit evaluator quotas.
boundaries.cancel: Composite tasks and the owned-state queue implement explicit cooperative transitions. A VM budget stop, process signal, or host interruption is not a general source cancellation/unwind operation.
boundaries.concurrent: Core excludes arbitrary threads, shared mutable memory, atomics and MMIO. Host dispatcher locks and safe-point checks do not establish a general concurrent-language memory model.
boundaries.crash: An incomplete or forcibly terminated native observation is rejected. The host retains process-cleanup ownership until termination/reap is confirmed, and a later reap cannot turn the failed observation into a successful return. Guest cleanup, guest resource ledgers, persistent-state recovery and replay safety are not established.
boundaries.error: Errors represented as values use the same checked normal-return rules. A failed fallible allocation still produces a logical empty owner that must be consumed.
boundaries.normal: Local owned resources and loans must be consumed or transferred through a checked signature; explicit v8 returned loans retain parameter origins and suspend callers until children end.
boundaries.recursive: Core recursive calls and finite owned chains are separate from static finite-budget profiles. Native recursion/stack bounds and universal termination are not established.
boundaries.trap: Default VM profiles retain the stopped resource ledger and native traps abort. The explicit raw-byte-dag-finite-heap-cleanup-v1 profile separately reserves a bounded journal before execution and discharges actual invocation-owned byte loans/formals/owners after a language trap or budget stop, retaining both ledgers. This does not establish general unwinding, host panic/OOM/process-termination cleanup, or a source/native cleanup theorem.

Independent Rust checks normalized primitive bytes; no raw nominal Rust authority or source-to-Core/backend refinement theorem.
Language stop ledgers retain their existing semantics; no universal implicit unwind, host RSS/stack or arbitrary native allocation bound.
Caller measurements remain trusted estimates, not independent performance attestations.
No atomic publication across all caller-owned fields or processes is established.
No new native NDU, solver, model, publication or application speedup qualification is claimed.
capabilities.scope: At most 32 candidate entries are processed under an iteration counter independent of caller-list mutation. The observation helper independently limits capture to 33 ordinary rows with four fixed fields each. Exact immutable typed leaves are validated and those same captured costs/program bindings feed proof admission, native support hashes and the observation digest. Deterministic caller-interleaving tests use controlled proof/native/clock doubles; real Core verification remains active.

Within one registered maintenance study, unconfirmed model/public/hidden process cleanup terminates remaining work before another owner call. Preparation consumes the work budget, checked again immediately before each owner admission; depleted clean budgets refuse without poisoning. Retain available usage and elapsed prefixes before fallible evidence writes. The selected regressions use controlled receipts and clocks.
exclusions: No operating-system hard deadline, arbitrary host scheduling bound or independent process-cleanup proof follows from controlled receipts.
No cross-invocation poison registry, hidden-file operating-system isolation or provider routing/weight attestation.
The previous frozen source identity is preserved and must reject changed code; no model generation or productivity qualification is granted.

capabilities.scope: Every catalog group is restricted to the types published by the selected primitive schema. Core v1 through v6 exclude chain; v7 and v8 expose chain consistently with existing operation availability. Reuse the existing authoritative verifier and exact schema dispatch.
exclusions: Catalog metadata grants no execution authority, native ABI or semantic proof.
No unsupported operation or version is admitted, and the latest v8 catalog bytes are unchanged.
The read limit does not bound all process memory, Clang CPU/RSS, temporary disk, JSON parsing or aggregate project work.
Repeated reads are not an immutable source snapshot or an atomic guarantee against noncooperating writers after the final comparison.
This scope does not change C/C++ language support, project migrator contracts, ABI equivalence, native execution, formal refinement or Rust admission authority.
capabilities.scope: The strict single-file C scalar migrator reads at most 256001 source bytes per initial read and each of two freshness rechecks. Initial input above the existing 256000-byte limit rejects with E_C_SIZE before Clang. Growth at a later check and OSError during any source read reject with E_C_SOURCE_RACE; no destination is published and a staged file is cleaned. Ordinary eligible input retains source/output digest and frontend-only status. Controls use actual Clang and the actual Hepta frontend with deterministic temporary-file growth and source I/O fault injection.

exclusions: The selected deterministic regressions do not qualify model-maintenance outcomes or establish AI development advantage.
Each actual experiment requires an exact source/tool/prompt-bound registration, freeze and independent generation review.
No OS hermeticity, hardware attestation, hard physical scheduling deadline or global resource-safety proof is established.
Cloud maintenance v1, V13 and prior capacity identities remain historical; model results are not pooled.
Manual review costs and OS file-cache or scheduling effects remain uncontrolled.
capabilities.scope: Distinct registration and owned transport for a separately registered six-cell local maintenance arm. prepare/freeze/run bind current source/tools, exact public prefixes and zero-generation controls before a separate independent generation review. Each complete public RPC is a cold worker/runtime in the existing owned process group and remaining wall budget. Four real local usage fields and complete native request/token-ID/response bindings are required; actual bounded evidence reads, monotone known-cost retention and explicit unknown receipt states prevent false accounting. Confirmed owner cleanup survives later receipt rejection; uncertain cleanup stops later cells. Twenty-six deterministic unit selectors use synthetic inference records and no actual model/native/socket work; separately retained native author controls and owned tokenizer probes are not model-maintenance results.
